errors.text: The proposed BCC refractory coating and macroscopic air-sliding experiment do not reconstruct the FCC FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanoindentation and friction simulation.
The proposed oxide-controlled mechanism conflicts with the target mechanism of temperature-induced lattice disorder, dislocation-density evolution, and softening.
The 250–300 °C degradation boundary is substantially below the target threshold of approximately 900 K.
The claimed initial improvement up to about 200 °C, 1–2-order wear-rate increase, and oxide-layer instability are not established by the cited evidence.
